escapes.summary: Compiler hardening tests used cards absent from the compact CI database.

escapes.summary: Architecture and platform generated outputs did not match their authoritative sources.
escapes.resolution: Platform and coverage sources now select their exact generated freshness checks through the path policy.

escapes.summary: The typed protection transition exposed stale compiler fingerprints and incorrect fail-closed behavior in damage and targeting consumers.

escapes.summary: Protection runtime discovery still rejected represented colored-source interactions after the first correction.
escapes.resolution: The exact protection consumers are covered by both replacement and damage shards in the machine-readable policy.

escapes.summary: A selected-action modal raced auto-pass and two long browser journeys timed out.

escapes.summary: The natural-winner browser journey assumed a late pass always opened a form even though the same legal pass can complete as an immediate priority action.
escapes.resolution: The journey now accepts either a form-backed choice or an authoritative immediate-action revision while preserving forced form submission when needed.

escapes.summary: Two durability-heavy browser journeys twice exceeded fixed timing assumptions while accepted combat and cast commands continued through persisted auto-pass transitions.
escapes.resolution: The journeys now wait for authoritative projected results across persisted transitions and retain bounded whole-test budgets; both focused witnesses pass headlessly against the CI compact database.

escapes.summary: The same durability-heavy browser journeys exposed two remaining one-seat capability assumptions: a fixed host-only attackers wait and a Seat B pass clicked after its projected capability transitioned.
escapes.resolution: One shared coordinator now advances only the currently authorized server pass until a strategic decision, seat-qualified opportunity, or projected result is reached; the two witnesses pass together in one headless worker against the CI compact database.

escapes.summary: The natural-winner journey reused a projected pass around a slow land transition and could count the pre-draw hand before the next seat's playable main-phase decision.
escapes.resolution: Authorized pass submissions are now keyed by decision ID, land confirmation snapshots the hand only after the card is currently playable, and the witness verifies distinct precombat and postcombat main-phase commander offers; both focused journeys passed together headlessly in 27.9 minutes against the CI compact database.

escapes.summary: The fixed-mana runtime component increased two independently ratcheted inventories while the handoff duplicated numerical metrics reserved for generated status reports.
escapes.resolution: Both handler inventories now ratchet at nineteen and the handoff links to generated frontier and architecture reports instead of copying grouped numerical metrics.

escapes.summary: The nightly mutation-and-soak job ran repository provenance validation from a depth-one checkout, so a valid recorded ancestor commit was unavailable to git cat-file.
escapes.resolution: The provenance-validating nightly mutation-and-soak job now fetches complete history, and the workflow policy test ratchets that exact job boundary.

escapes.summary: The natural-winner journey observed the expected main-phase projection before React made its commander offer actionable, then its own progress helper submitted the phase pass it was intended to verify.
escapes.resolution: The seat-opportunity helper now anchors the expected active seat and exact projected phase while its strategic offer settles, preventing the test driver from consuming the opportunity under observation or matching the next player's same-named main phase.

escapes.summary: The natural-winner journey armed Full Control only after a preceding command could auto-advance through the defender's next precombat main phase, so the test driver searched for an opportunity that had already passed.
escapes.resolution: The journey now arms the defender's stop before each preceding turn-transition command, advances only intervening responses, and holds a seat-qualified precombat main phase while its exact land action settles instead of submitting the pass under observation.

escapes.summary: Generated status dependencies were maintained as copied command lists, so refreshing platform readiness exposed stale architecture outputs and then stale reusable-piece fingerprints on consecutive exact heads.
escapes.resolution: A strict ownership manifest now orders all tracked generators, one finalizer writes them to a bounded fixed point, AGENTS.md requires that command before the final commit, and a repository pre-push hook rejects omitted generated changes.

escapes.summary: The Bloodthirst family registered a new runtime component, but its focused tests did not assert global registration and a fragile hard-coded component count failed only in the compiler-cardprogram shard.
escapes.resolution: The Bloodthirst-focused module now verifies exact component registration, while the global trust test checks unique handler identities and the complete family set instead of a maintenance-only total count.

escapes.summary: Ordinary Amass runtime tests resolved three token and replacement-component records from the full local card database, while those records were absent from the canonical compact CI database.

escapes.summary: Ordinary Echo runtime tests resolved Karmic Guide and Shah of Naar Isle from the full local card database, but those cards were absent from the canonical compact CI database; this was a recurrence of the Amass fixture-omission class.

The compact dependency closure now structurally discovers card, Oracle-ID, helper, and deck requirements and blocks pull-request matrices before long shards when the canonical manifest is incomplete.

escapes.summary: The combat declaration family registered three new static runtime components, but the focused local evidence omitted the global family-inventory ratchet; this recurred after the Bloodthirst registration escape.
escapes.resolution: The declaration-focused witness now verifies the three exact registered families and their shared capability dependency, the global ratchet includes those families, and AGENTS.md requires that exact global inventory test in any authorized focused check for registration changes.

escapes.summary: The typed activation-tail harvest correctly promoted Scryb Ranger from partial to exact, but an existing compiler regression still asserted the prior partial status.

The path policy already selected compiler-cardprogram, so no missing impact edge existed; the incident remains recorded to prevent stale promotion assertions from being overlooked during focused compiler harvest review.

escapes.resolution: The scheduler regression now includes the fixed-effect sequence candidate. Selector inputs already select generated validation, so the defect was a stale closed expectation rather than a missing impact edge.

escapes.summary: The composition compiler correctly promoted fixed mass damage followed by Scry, but the leaf compiler regression still asserted that the complete two-clause ability remained residual.
escapes.resolution: The composition suite now asserts the promoted operation sequence while the leaf suite retains only unsupported mass-damage forms. The path policy already selected the affected shard.

The obsolete Haste grant was removed from the action-permission residual table because the fixed-query composition suite already asserts that exact promoted form. The existing AGENTS.md cross-leaf audit rule mechanically covers future grammar promotions, and the path policy already selected both affected shards.

escapes.summary: The Devoid harvest registered a capability-bound runtime component, but its focused local evidence omitted the global family-inventory ratchet despite the registration-change review rule.
escapes.resolution: The Devoid-focused compiler witness now verifies the exact registered family, handler, capability dependency, and trusted closure, while the global closed inventory includes that family. The existing impact policy already selected compiler-cardprogram; the focused module now makes the registration obligation executable in the locally permitted Devoid check.

escapes.resolution: Main certification now combines commit-associated and recent closed pull-request payloads, deduplicates the same PR by number, and still requires exactly one matching merge SHA. Focused unit coverage and a real PR 274 receipt verification exercise the fallback.

escapes.summary: The next squash merge repeated the empty commit-associated PR response and failed Main smoke before dependency installation, confirming the prior receipt lookup was deterministically incomplete.
escapes.resolution: Main certification now combines commit-associated and recent closed pull-request payloads, deduplicates the same PR by number, and still requires exactly one matching merge SHA. Empty and ambiguous selections remain fail-closed.

escapes.resolution: The existing @mana-action impact edge already selected the journey. The driver now uses the bounded progress-aware multi-page pass loop before asserting the Bowmasters target choice and shares the 600-second hosted durability budget used by adjacent long serial journeys.

escapes.summary: The affected-player sacrifice capability declarations cited only the rules individually exercised by several evidence rows and were inserted out of canonical evidence-class order, so the cloud capability-evidence owner rejected the source before generation.

The existing quick-gate impact already selects capability evidence; source-checkpoint preparation now runs update_capability_evidence.py --check and accepts only the expected stale-output result before cloud generation.

escapes.summary: The fixed mana-value target harvest added CR 202.3 to the tap-and-untap mechanic contract, but its focused local set omitted the contract's exact rule-reference trace assertion.

The cloud workflow already selected and failed in the exact rules-scheduler owner, so the correction adds a direct formatter regression rather than a new impact edge.

escapes.summary: After the Markdown writer accepted an explicit empty selection, final rules verification independently treated the same selected_candidate_id null value as a missing cross-program work-selection payload.

It accepts null only when the declared and observed eligible counts are zero and rejects missing, ineligible, multiply selected, or inconsistent rows, preventing a third consumer-specific assumption.

escapes.summary: The generated queue, Markdown writer, rules verifier, and next-work API all accepted the explicit empty selection, but an older governance assertion still unconditionally subscripted the API's selected_work null result.

A repository-wide selected_work and selected_candidate_id audit found no other unconditional production or test consumer; generated validation was already selected on the exact head.

Krovikan Plague now proves complete CardProgram admission remains fail-closed because of its activated residuals, while the obsolete typed-Enchant residual pair declaration is removed and positive Aura/delayed-draw composition owns that promoted edge. The existing compiler and trigger impact paths already selected the failing shard.

escapes.summary: The selector correctly recorded the fixed Flashback harvest as its thirteenth observed outcome, but one governance test pinned the prior total of twelve instead of deriving it from the authoritative history.
escapes.resolution: The calibration regression now derives observed count, subthreshold count, absolute prediction error, and trailing subthreshold count from the authoritative harvest history and configured card floor. Generated validation was already selected on the exact head, so no new impact edge is required.

escapes.summary: The registered Flashback runtime component correctly declared its capability family, but the closed global runtime-family inventory test still omitted casting.flashback.fixed_mana.
escapes.resolution: The closed runtime-family inventory now includes the Flashback component. The existing compiler/CardProgram impact path already selected the failing shard; focused preparation for future runtime-registry additions must run the global inventory method in addition to the new component's own tests.

The family-indexed change-impact policy now links static-characteristic compiler owners to both their positive owner tests and neighboring dynamic exact/residual expectations.

The family-indexed policy links activated-cost compiler owners to these neighboring capability, exact/residual, mutation, and interaction modules before the next push.

The recovery planner now proves the latest failed main SHA, immutable run and Ubuntu job IDs, matching shard artifact, exact failing test module, affected-owner generated outputs, unchanged nonfailing tests and decorators, and structurally identical assertions before selecting the focused recovery profile.

escapes.summary: The natural-winner browser soak reached a legal Combat.Attackers decision while searching for the next land offer, but its custom progress callback could submit only priority passes and reported success even when it submitted nothing.
escapes.resolution: The shared action-ready driver now submits the legal empty-attacker declaration when that mandatory choice blocks a later action and returns false when no authorized command was submitted, allowing the progress coordinator to apply its own bounded fallback and watchdog. The strict main-red audit now consumes exact-source Playwright reports and permits only report- or stack-named test harness changes with unchanged test bodies, tags, and assertions; recovery-authority repairs use an exact-base complete high-risk fix-forward instead of self-authorizing focused CI. The existing browser-soak inventory selected the failing journey, so no new impact edge is required.

The generated-owner plan and existing source mappings already select the frontier, scheduler, and both focused regression modules, so no new impact edge is required.

escapes.summary: The public-event harvest promoted five counter-placement trigger forms, but the first source checkpoint did not run the owning module's adjacent residual inventory, which still classified those exact forms as unsupported.

The existing compiler-family impact edge already selected the owning module; future pre-cloud evidence for a promoted grammar must include its exact adjacent positive/residual boundary method rather than only the newly added runtime tests.

escapes.resolution: The shared compiler-activated-cost-expectations rule now routes every activation-cost owner to the counter-placement consumer inventory, capability mutations, modal and target composition expectations, and high-risk interaction assurance. Frontier evaluation derives its exact bounded combination count from the current family universe, and the global fail-closed witness executes every declared pair without pinning a volatile total. Existing complete compiler impact selection already includes all affected modules.
